goal: Retained exact own-output unseen four-operation and mixed arithmetic per all training samples and compute, learned from real answers during warmup and ultimately scalar 0/1 without arithmetic rules, attention or Transformers.
counts_warning: These are overlapping historical views, not additive or unique surviving candidates.

D1.name: 学得题面保留与独立生成工作状态
D1.operation: 普通递归/门控保留一个学得题面状态，生成状态逐字节演化且始终受其普通仿射条件影响；不检索位置或KV。
D1.existing_limit: 旧GRU已递归，增加8次计算的旧R8也失败；本方向不是再增加次数或ELM私有状态。题面快照条件化是未测新版本。

D2.name: 整段实际动作的延迟资格与信用
D2.operation: 在生成整串回答时保存有界动作特异信用，真实0/1到达后更新参与生成的可学习状态/参数。
D2.existing_limit: 旧Z1没有改善且修正E3较差；A_ELIG证据来自其他底物。当前答案监督已覆盖题内全部梯度，不能把失败说成32-event信用截断。V24/V25只有四动作反馈。

D3.name: 奖励预期调制与可学习预测基线
D3.operation: 只从实际奖励学习预期，用实际奖励与预期的差异调制动作信用；不提供正确答案或数值误差。
D3.existing_limit: 旧V24/V25已有reward-minus-chosen-value；不是新发现，也尚未证明可训练通用字节表示。旧预训练教师和SAC复合结果不继承。

D4.name: 表示与输出联合学习及优化一致性
D4.operation: 在可见答案阶段联合训练categorical encoder/readout；在scalar阶段使用与真实动作和奖励一致的目标。
D4.existing_limit: 当前SOURCE-CELL已联合CE训练但获取仍弱；方向是优化/结构的配套约束，非额外已成功的昆虫机制。固定特征RLS历史成功不能继承。

D5.name: 收费的交错重复与有界再激活
D5.operation: 真实观察的重复和跨难度交错，不用模型猜测伪造答案；所有存储、选择、曝光和算力计费。
D5.existing_limit: reservoir/recent/REPLAY-P/REPLAY-U/COV-REPLAY已测；旧纯字节模型充分重复可记已教题，却未学会可靠未见乘法。不是主机制或未试的新办法。

clarifications: A file named elm_fly is not automatically an ELM cell: memory/update rules must be identified by operation.
V23/V24 FastWeightsMemory is a decaying output matrix, not QKV attention. Its exact recipes remain low priority on evidence, not by an attention label.
V24/V25 already tested scalar chosen-action reward and eligibility; four-action associative performance is not end-to-end byte sequence credit or arithmetic generalization.
Current SOURCE-CELL W already had actual correct reply/EOS supervision and full frame credit; insufficient answer availability or 32-event truncation cannot explain those technical trajectories.
U042 names in the historical 71 subset and the OBSERVATION_SUPPORT experiment are different operations. Likewise SUPPORT-DIR and historical bayes_reopening must not be conflated.
A learned prompt snapshot/conditioned decoder is a new generic version, not an existing successful biological scratchpad or address/content split.
Partial positive synthetic choices, retention and revision remain valid within their source scope. Do not convert them into four-operation capability or erase them on present-task failure.

biological_sources.supports: Recurrent sensory/output feedback to DANs and integrated predictions in larval associative learning; not arithmetic algorithms.
Timing-sensitive bidirectional odor-association plasticity via dopamine receptors; not a demonstrated generic sequence credit rule.
